documents.title: Press Release - Premier Green Innovations Private Limited, Associate Company Of Almondz Global Securities Limited, Secures Ethanol Allocation From Oil Marketing Companies For ESY 2026-27
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation

analysis.summary: Management reported a strong second quarter for Almondz Global Securities with consolidated total revenue growing 17.9% year-on-year to INR40.09 crores and profit rising 2.4x to INR9.13 crores. The infrastructure consultancy business secured INR154 crores of new orders in the first half, taking its total order book to over INR400 crores, while the green fuel joint venture Premier Green Innovations achieved high capacity utilization and secured ethanol allocations. The company is actively progressing with a demerger scheme to list the infrastructure consultancy business independently to unlock shareholder value. Meanwhile, the financial services and merchant banking advisory segments maintain a healthy pipeline of mandates. The Annual Report of Almondz Global Securities Limited for the financial year 2025-26 outlines the company's standalone and consolidated financial performance, subsidiary highlights, and corporate governance practices.

guidance.claim: The company expects the demerger process of the infrastructure consultancy business to be completed and finally listed in six to nine months.
guidance.quote: We expect anywhere between 6 months' time to 9 months' time for the entire process to be completed and it being finally listed.

guidance.claim: Management projects all three of its businesses to grow at least 25% year-on-year.
guidance.quote: And as well as the 5-year growth projections of the company, we are expecting strong growth and each of our businesses, all three businesses of ours would not be growing less than 25% at least year-on-year basis.

demand_outlook.claim: Order inflows for the infrastructure business have been very encouraging with INR154 crores secured in the first half.
demand_outlook.quote: Order inflows have been particularly very encouraging. We secured INR154 crores of new orders in H1. 2.4x of INR72 crores won in the last quarter, this last year, first quarter last year, first half year last year.

demand_outlook.claim: The management sees significant headroom in railways, urban development, and geolab, alongside maintaining positioning in highways.
demand_outlook.quote: We see significant headroom in railways, urban development, and geolab, besides maintaining our strong positioning in the highway section.

demand_outlook.claim: The underlying franchise of financial services remains very healthy with a strong pipeline of merchant banking advisory mandates.
demand_outlook.quote: The underlying franchise remains very healthy. Our merchant banking advisory business has a strong pipeline of mandates under execution, including fundraisers, right issues, and IP advisory.

capex_expansion.claim: The 200 KLPD Odisha greenfield plant is fully operational now and produced 71 lakh liters of ethanol in its initial phase.
capex_expansion.quote: The 200 KLPD Odisha greenfield plant is fully operational now. It produced 71 lakh liters of ethanol in its initial phase.

capex_expansion.claim: The Himachal Pradesh unit operated at full capacity of 285 kiloliters per day and delivered revenue of 202.24 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: The Himachal Pradesh unit operated at full capacity of 285 kiloliters per day. And delivered revenue of 202.24 crores in this quarter in the last quarter, up 55.7%, with profit rising 3.4x times to INR12.59 crores.

margins_costs.claim: On a consolidated basis, Almondz Global Securities profit margin expanded by 11.4 basis points to 22.8%.
margins_costs.quote: While profit rose 2.4x to INR9.13 crores, profit margin expanded by 11.4 basis points to 22.8%.

orders_capacity.claim: The total order book for the infrastructure business is now over INR400 crores to be executed over the next 3 to 4 years.
orders_capacity.quote: And our total order book is now over INR400 crores to be executed over next 3 to 4 years.

orders_capacity.claim: Almondz Global Infra Consultancy Limited won its largest ever sole bid of INR33 crores program management consultancy mandate from Odisha Industrial Infrastructure Development Corporation.
orders_capacity.quote: During the quarter, Almondz Global Infra Consultancy Limited won its largest ever sole bid, of INR33 crores program management consultancy mandate from Odisha Industrial Infrastructure Development Corporation.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has been allocated 12.80 crores liters of supply of ethanol from Himachal and Odisha, taking plants to nearly 100% capacity utilization.
orders_capacity.quote: As of yesterday, we have been allocated 12.80 crores liters of supply of ethanol from Himachal and Odisha. This combined will take both our plants to nearly 100% of capacity utilization.

orders_capacity.claim: Premier Green Innovations Private Limited has a grain based distillery in Himachal Pradesh with 200 KLPD capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: PGIPL has grain based distillery in Himachal Pradesh with 200 KLPD capacity.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects full supply from OMC tenders to start from the third week of November.
management_commitments.quote: We have participated in the OMC tenders for financial year '27. And full supply is expected from 3rd week of November.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
